name: Delegation Expiry and Revocation
description: Delegated authority has a TTL. Revocation propagates immediately. Cascading revocation for transitive delegations.
acceptanceCriteria: Every delegation has a mandatory TTL (time-to-live).
Expired delegations cannot be used for authority decisions.
Revocation propagates immediately to all downstream delegations.
Cascading revocation handles transitive delegation chains correctly.
Revocation events are recorded in the evidence chain.
